messages:
maya: Heads-up — thinking about a 'scoping preview' grid in the console to show effective permissions per-route/model. Quick sketch in Figma. Need to discuss discoverability, telemetry, and export behavior.

aj: Can you drop the Figma link? /cc @kelly for enterprise needs.

maya: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234 — its rough: collapsible rows by role, columns = routes/models, badges for overrides.

kelly: High-level: enterprise customers want a single-pane view that answers 'who can do what' quickly. Big tenant worry: grid noise. Suggest default collapsed state + top-5 routes by traffic.

sagar: From API side we have /v1/tenants/:id/permissions/effective which returns full matrix and is heavy for large tenants. Proposal: add /summary endpoint that returns role-level counts + top-N offending routes to render the collapsed view. Cacheable with ETag.

pranav: Design notes: collapse by role, show override badge and hover detail. Add toggle 'effective vs explicit' to switch between computed permissions and explicit grants. Mini usage sparklines in column header to tie to quotas/telemetry.

aj: How do rollouts affect this? If we have canary routing or fallback policies, preview must reflect active routing policy per-model. Need a 'policy' column or inline tooltip.

kelly: Also enterprise asked for direct audit links from cells (who changed what). Export (CSV) is a must for compliance. Would prefer export be async for large tenants.

maya: Telemetry: track open/close of the grid and toggle flips. Suggested event names: ui.permissions_preview_open (tenant masked), ui.permissions_toggle_mode, ui.permissions_export_initiated. Keep PII out.

sagar: Backend plan: implement summary endpoint + TTL cache (30s–2m), add export job that materializes full matrix to S3 and returns a presigned URL. Mark export as 'ready' under /exports endpoint so UI can poll.

deploy-bot: deploy: permissions-service v1.42 deployed to staging at 2026-03-19T02:15Z :rocket:

pranav: Accessibility: ensure keyboard navigation across grid cells and screen-reader announcements for state changes (collapsed/expanded, overrides). Add aria labels for export status.

kelly: :thumbsup: MVP proposal: ship summary grid + discovery microcopy + telemetry + async export behind org-level feature flag. Ramp to 10% orgs for 2 weeks, collect usage and performance telemetry.

maya: Action items: Sagar — API spec PR + summary endpoint by EOD Fri; Pranav — update Figma with collapse states and accessibility notes; Kelly — draft rollout + telemetry plan and feature-flag gating. I'll write an RFC once PRs land.

aj: One more thing — rate-limit the UI calls. Grid rendering could trigger many requests for users clicking around. Add client-side debounce and server-side burst guard.

sagar: Agreed. We'll add a server sentinel that replies with a short summary when burst detected and a header to signal 'partial' view.

maya: Thanks all. Ping here if you hit blockers or need tradeoffs documented.
